pairs.evidence: src/athena/core/catalog.py:522 Capability overflow removes still-registered tools from the documented roster instead of preserving every active name and purpose while reducing detail.

techniques.evidence: src/athena/core/catalog.py:522 Overflow skips complete tool entries while their registrations remain active; tests/core/test_catalog.py explicitly checks that omitted tools still validate.

src/athena/core/prompt.py:131 The composer checks character tripwires independently and returns warnings; it neither derives nor enforces a total token budget accounting for the model window, response reservation and safety margin.

src/athena/core/prompt.py:471 The default assembly path generates randomness internally, so identical declared inputs produce different frame bytes instead of receiving the actual nonce as an explicit input.

techniques.evidence: src/athena/harness/rounds.py:130 Hashes cover input blocks once per turn, excluding the appended task and subsequent round feedback; the API/CLI send paths and ledger hook do not persist the required digest and size of each complete prompt sent.
src/athena/harness/rounds.py:399 The task is concatenated onto pre-rendered frame blocks after before_prompt and block hashing; later result messages are also assembled outside that checked artifact.
